name: Algebraic State Machine Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit Python firewall loop (which models easily pattern-matched to a sequential flow-shop constraint) with an algebraic tracker that increments and resets. To realize this implies the exact same `p1 + p2 > T` constraint, the model must logically deduce that reaching the maximum possible sum requires all resets to strictly precede all increments without overlapping.
